basis: Pontocerebellar hypoplasia and intellectual disability define disease; visual impairment and sensorineural hearing loss are each frequent (30–79%).
Carcinoma originates in the ovary, a reproductive organ outside the axes; advanced disease alone does not establish another organ.
Congenital finger contractures and sacral vertebral fusion are skeletal and joint abnormalities.
Hemiplegic migraine and developmental/epileptic encephalopathy define a neurologic spectrum.
Potassium depletion is an electrolyte disorder; paralysis, rhabdomyolysis and nephropathy concern severe cases, without evidence of ≥30% involvement.
Cerebellar ataxia/atrophy and pyramidal signs define disease; frequent flat feet alone do not establish functionally damaging skeletal involvement.
Childhood malignancy of blood cells and marrow; common damaging involvement of another organ is not established across this umbrella.
Inherited sterol metabolism disorder; hepatic, cutaneous and neurologic manifestations vary across subtypes.
RAX2-related degeneration of the retinal macula.
Nonsyndromic cataract affecting the lens; developmental cataract reported in 7/7 patients.
Tumour originates in cutaneous eccrine sweat glands of the vulva.
SAMD9 predisposition spectrum defined by marrow myelodysplasia/leukemia risk; susceptibility does not establish MIRAGE-related extra-marrow damage.
Congestive splenic enlargement destroys blood cells and causes pancytopenia; underlying portal hypertension or cirrhosis is a separate condition.
Oral/limb malformations and intellectual deficit define syndrome; epiglottic hypoplasia is a characteristic diagnostic airway malformation.
Polyp occupies the maxillary sinus, an upper respiratory tract structure; mouth and skeletal parent terms do not establish involvement.
Severe intellectual disability and spasticity are neurologic; pigmentary tapetoretinal degeneration directly affects the retina.
Treponemal infection of the central nervous system with subclinical meningeal inflammation, despite absence of neurologic symptoms.
Hereditary skin, hair and follicular disorder; anemia and liposarcoma annotations appear mixed with other Bazex entities and do not justify extra axes.
Letrozole inhibits aromatase and estrogen synthesis; endocrine assignment is provisional because no specific toxicity phenotype or organ injury is supplied.
Intraductal breast epithelial lesion; breast has no axis.
Pure personality disorder without defined damage to an organ axis.
Skeletal malformations, severe ID and cleft palate define syndrome; eyelid coloboma/ptosis occur in 80–99%. Common nail/skin defects omitted by cap; GU anomalies <30%.
Congenital ventricular, atrioventricular septal and pulmonary outflow defects; pulmonary stenosis is cardiovascular, and heterotaxy alone adds no axis.
Multiple peripheral, spinal or intracranial nerve-sheath tumours define disease; peripheral schwannomas in 2/2. Cutaneous location does not establish skin damage.
Isolated inverted nipples are a breast abnormality, outside the organ axes.
